item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 9 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 9 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 12:52 AM, 08 November 2026(Sunday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Batangas (Padre Garcia, Rosario, Santo Tomas, Lipa, San Juan, Malvar, Balete, and Mataasnakahoy), Laguna (San Pablo, Rizal, Calauan, Victoria, Santa Cruz, Magdalena, Pagsanjan, Pila, Luisiana, Alaminos, Bay, Los Banos, and Cavinti), and Quezon (Sampaloc, Mauban, Pagbilao, Lucena, Tiaong, San Antonio, Padre Burgos, Atimonan, Lopez, Gumaca, Plaridel, Unisan, Burdeos, Panukulan, Jomalig, Patnanungan, Polillo, and Agdangan) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Laguna (Majayjay, Liliw, and Nagcarlan) and Quezon (Sariaya, Tayabas, Candelaria, Lucban, Dolores, Quezon, Alabat, Perez, and Calauag) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
